ChatGPT said:ChatGPT

You can remove the .043″ / 1.1 mm gauge button with one small change to your existing GitHub code. This keeps the rest of your Chainsaw Sharpening app unchanged.

Open index.html in GitHub, click the pencil icon, and find this line near the beginning of the <script> section:

Find:

JavaScript

const G=[
".043″ / 1.1 mm",
".050″ / 1.3 mm",
".058″ / 1.5 mm",
".063″ / 1.6 mm"
];

Replace with:

JavaScript

const G=[
".050″ / 1.3 mm",
".058″ / 1.5 mm",
".063″ / 1.6 mm"
];

Then find:

JavaScript

const GAUGE_MAP={
43:G[0],
50:G[1],
58:G[2],
63:G[3]
};

Replace with:

JavaScript

const GAUGE_MAP={
43:".043″ / 1.1 mm",
50:G[0],
58:G[1],
63:G[2]
};

This second change is important because it keeps the other gauge references assigned correctly.

Result

Your Select chain gauge section will display:

.050″ / 1.3 mm

.058″ / 1.5 mm

.063″ / 1.6 mm

The .043″ button will be gone, while your existing .325″ and 3/8″ reference lines remain intact. The 90SG .043″ entry remains in the code but cannot be selected through the gauge buttons.

Click Commit changes, then refresh your GitHub Pages website.
